_doc: Task 65/66 (scripts/systems/daily_hook.gd): personal hooks the involvement director (data/director.json) may pick, never on a clock: favour (someone the pawn knows, friendship >= favour_min, asks to borrow money; a ripple names the friend and uses its own line), problem (StorytellerTilt on a real home incident: the odds of its own roll only), wallet (a real customer on the same lot leaves a wallet behind). One plain line and a choice.

favour: {n} calls. "Bit awkward... could you lend me {c} coins till next week?"
{n} catches you: "I'm short {c} for the rent. Any chance?"
lent: You hand over {c} coins. {n} looks relieved. "I won't forget this."
refused: "No, that's fair. Don't worry about it." {n} sounds disappointed.
repaid: {n} pays you back the {c} coins, with thanks.
stiffed: It's been a while. {n} still hasn't paid back the {c} coins, and doesn't mention it.
wallet: A wallet is lying on the seat where {n} was sitting.
returned: You catch {n} at the door. "My wallet! Thank you!"
kept_seen: {n} comes back for it, and sees it in your hand. "That's mine."
left: You leave it where it is.
favour_ripple: {n} calls, upset. "I'm in a hole. Could you spare {c} coins? Just till things settle."
